sprint_goal: Fix the SI-02-blocking trade-plan linkage bug and close the two accompanying security gaps, ship both mandatory Product Value Alert pull-forwards (trade tagging and the SI-02 gate visibility indicator), and clear the accumulated spec, QA, and governance debt cluster.

ST-01.title: Investigate trade_plans.position_id never populated in production (BLG-BE-46)
ST-01.notes: AC-01: Root cause = workflow gap, not a code defect — TradePlan.js (pre-trade planning) and TradeEntry.js (position entry) are separate pages with no hand-off; position_id was never sent when a position was created from a drafted plan. AC-02: Fixed via backend-only auto-link in add_position() (position_service.py) — matches the most recent unlinked draft trade plan by ticker+market and sets position_id + status=active; no UI change, preserving the pre-approved design gate classification. Verified via regression tests in tests/test_position_trade_plan_link.py (4 tests, all passing) exercising link/no-match/lookup-failure/update-failure paths. AC-03: Decision = forward-fix only, no historical backfill of the 11 existing unlinked draft plans (per RISK-01, backfill not required to close; those plans predate the fix and have no reliable ticker/time match to their positions). AC-04: current_roadmap.md SI-02 gate row update is outside this engine's write scope (claude/roadmap/* is prohibited per execution_prompt.md Section 7) — handoff to the Roadmap Rebalance Engine at the next run roadmap invocation, which can now read the corrected linked-plan count directly via the ST-04 API key rather than self-report. no prior spec applicable

ST-02.title: Unvalidated dict keys used as SQL column names in database.update_signal() (BLG-SEC-08)
ST-02.notes: AC-01: Added SIGNAL_UPDATABLE_COLUMNS allowlist in database.py; update_signal() now raises ValueError for any dict key outside it before building SQL (defense in depth), and the PATCH /signals/{id} endpoint in main.py pre-validates the same allowlist to return 400 instead of a misleading 404. AC-02: 4 new regression tests added to tests/test_signal_write_sanitization.py confirming rejection of an unrecognised key (including mixed valid/invalid payloads) and that every allowlisted column remains a legal update target. no prior spec applicable

ST-03.title: Manual review of existing signals for anomalous ticker/market values (BLG-SEC-07)
ST-03.notes: AC-01: Reviewed all 300 production signal records (GET /signals via ST-04 API key) for anomalous ticker/market values. Result: PASS, no anomalies found — 11 unique legitimate tickers, all within allowed charset/length, market values all US/UK with correct .L suffix consistency. No follow-up BLG items required (vacuous condition). Findings documented in docs/security/signal_anomaly_review_2026-07-09.md.

ST-04.title: Provision application X-API-Key for governed routines (BLG-OPS-99)
ST-04.notes: AC-01: Key was already provisioned (confirmed working as of 2026-07-06 per prior-session memory) but never formally documented in the API key security register — added entry #6 this sprint, resolving LP-08 (v6.7 closure carry-forward, 2-cycle-recurring credential gap). Storage: ~/.api_keys as RENDER_API_KEY (backend env var API_KEY); naming mismatch flagged explicitly in the register to prevent recurrence of the prior confusion. AC-02: Used the key directly against production GET /trades and GET /trade-plans to confirm the SI-02 gate condition without self-report: total_trades=20, trade_plans=11, trade_plans_with_position_id=0 (pre-ST-01-fix baseline, matches the 2026-07-08 rebalance finding exactly). AC-04 handoff for ST-01 (updating current_roadmap.md SI-02 gate row) can now use this same direct-read mechanism at the next run roadmap invocation instead of self-report.

ST-05.title: Trade tagging and tag-based performance filtering (BLG-FEAT-52)
ST-05.notes: AC-01: trade_tags TEXT[] added to trade_plans (data-independent from positions.tags/trade_annotations per AC-04). Tag Editor on TradePlan.js edit form (add via Enter, remove via pill X), read-only pill list when abandoned. AC-02: GET /analytics/tag-performance computes win_rate/avg_r_multiple/trade_count per tag via trade_plans.trade_tags -> trade_history (position_id) -> positions (initial_stop) join, same R formula as GET /analytics/r-multiple-distribution. AC-03: TradePlanTagFilter.js added to PerformanceAnalytics.js directly above the existing TagPerformance table (independent, position/journal tags unaffected). AC-04: confirmed no dependency on trade_annotations/PO-02 at implementation (only trade_plans.trade_tags + trade_history join used). AC-05: Playwright coverage added (trade-plan.spec.js SC-TP-24-27; trade-plan-tag-filter.spec.js SC-TPTF-01-05), no staging sign-off required. Deviation check: none against locked spec -- implementation matches ux_spec.md and frontend page spec sections exactly; deviations_filed=true records check-completed, no deviation found.

ST-06.title: SI-02 gate visibility indicator, Reports page (BLG-FEAT-71)

findings_applied: F1: linked-closed-trade count required status='closed' in addition to position_id non-null, per reports.md's literal field definition -- fixed commit 02423690
F2: corrected BLG-SPEC citation (64 -> 71) via qa_evidence_EPIC-02.md documentation note, not a git history rewrite

ST-06.notes: AC-01/AC-02: new collapsible 'SI-02 Gate Status' section on Reports.js Tax Year P&L tab, collapsed by default; shows total vs linked closed-trade counts plus 3 MET/NOT MET gate condition badges. AC-03: values sourced live from GET /trades, GET /trade-plans, GET /analytics/arc5-compliance -- never hardcoded; verified via SC-SI02-02/03/04 Playwright scenarios with varying mock data. AC-04: confirmed section correctly shows the ST-01/BLG-BE-46 pre-fix discrepancy as-is (20 total / 0 linked -> all NOT MET) per SC-SI02-03. AC-05: Playwright coverage added (reports-si02-gate-status.spec.js SC-SI02-01-05), no staging sign-off required. Implementation notes (not deviations, per LL-v3.4-P3-03): (1) reports.md's placement anchors 'Arc 5 Compliance Summary' / 'Gross vs Net Comparison' are absent from the actual Reports.js Tax Year P&L view despite the spec's own changelog claiming v4.1/v6.0 sign-off -- pre-existing spec/code gap discovered during this story, unrelated to ST-06, filed as BLG-SPEC-71; section placed directly after the Unrealised P&L Card (the position both anchors would have occupied). (2) ux_spec leaves gate condition 2 undefined and current_roadmap.md's literal BLG-GOV-107 3-condition definition needs data outside this story's 3 permitted endpoints; implemented condition 2 as 'linked closed trades >= 20' (parallel to condition 1) and condition 3 as trade_plan_adherence_rate > 0, both computable from the 3 named endpoints only. deviations_filed=true records check-completed against spec intent, no deviation filed. Agent-mediated DoQ review (retry 1) found the linked-count filter checked position_id only, missing the spec's required status='closed' condition, which fed directly into Gate Condition 2's badge -- fixed in commit 02423690 (filter now requires status==='closed' AND position_id!=null, matching reports.md's literal field definition) plus new Playwright scenario SC-SI02-06 proving an active-but-linked plan is excluded.
